messages:
devon_support: URGENT: Escalating AcmeCove onboarding — embedded responses returning 500s intermittently, SSO setup stalled (idp cert mismatch), billing flagged overage on their trial. Renewal in 30d, have exec check-in scheduled.

maria_cs: @devon_support thanks — can you summarize latest logs + who's on the call? tagging @alex_head_of_cs for exec lane.

devon_support: Summary:
- First failure: 2024-11-12 08:32 UTC, prefix caching NPE then 500s for /v1/embeddings
- SSO: IdP cert mismatch reported by their Okta admin, blocked on SAML metadata update
- Billing: automatic threshold hit, account set to manual review
- They've tried 2 restarts, no config changes

Sample error snippet:
```
2024-11-12T08:32:12Z ERROR runtime: prefix_cache.go:142 nil pointer deref
stack: ...
request_id=ab12cd
```

Goal: avoid renewal churn. Need CS ownership, comms plan for exec check-in + technical remediation call.

ira_csm: I'll take ownership. ✅ Planning immediate steps:
1) Acknowledge to customer within 1hr
2) Book triage + enablement session in next 24h (50m technical deep-dive)
3) Assign SE (sam_se) to run logs + repro
4) Hold internal sync with finance for billing waiver

I'll create invite now. @sam_se can you join the triage?

sam_se: I can join today 10:30 PT. I'll prep a repro checklist and ask for debug bundle.

alex_head_of_cs: Looping finance + sales ops. We'll propose a temporary credit and postpone renewal discussions until stability confirmed. I can join the exec call if needed.

deploy-bot: @channel New calendar invite created: "AcmeCove Onboard Triage" Thu Nov 14 17:30 UTC — attendees: ira_csm, sam_se, devon_support, acmecove-admin

maria_cs: Comms template for initial ack (use this):
```
Hi <Customer> — received your report and prioritizing. Our CSM (Ira) will reach out within 1hr to schedule a triage. We're escalating to Engineering and Finance to prevent service interruption. — Maria, Redwood CS
```

ira_csm: Internal comms plan:
- 1hr: Ack email from CS
- <24h: Triage + repro with SE
- 48-72h: Hotfix or rollback plan OR escalation to product
- 5 days: Stability report + exec update

Action items:
- @devon_support: attach debug bundle + support logs to thread (done)
- @sam_se: repro checklist + needed perms
- @alex_head_of_cs: confirm finance waiver
- @maria_cs: prepare exec summary for renewal postponement

devon_support: debug bundle uploaded to /s3/acmecove/debug-ab12cd.tar.gz and link in ticket #12345

sam_se: Got it. I'll try to repro locally with same model/config. If prefix cache is culprit we can toggle cache=off on their Dedicated node as a stopgap.

ira_csm: Great. I'll DM acmecove-exec to confirm exec call time after triage. Will update thread with meeting notes. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Thanks team. Marking as P1->CS action. :eyes:
